Pivot the harmonized time series into wide format (one column per concept)

Source: R/access_core.R
fetch_concepts_wide.Rd

Reads the harmonized long table (ts_tab for admission grain, or the ts_icu projection for ICU grain) and pivots it to wide format entirely in SQL via conditional aggregation - the long table is never pulled into R.

Usage

fetch_concepts_wide(
  src_name,
  spec,
  bin_min = 60,
  analysis_level = c("admission", "icu"),
  window = NULL,
  complete_grid = FALSE,
  n = Inf,
  cohort_only = TRUE,
  clean = c("none", "range"),
  ranges = NULL,
  con = NULL,
  case_adm_only,
  scope_only
)

Arguments

src_name

Source name (e.g. "mimic_iv_demo").

spec

Named list mapping each concept to a character vector of aggregates. Supported: "min", "max", "mean", "median", "sd", "variance", "sum", "n"/"count", "first", and "last"; "all_numeric" expands to all numeric reducers. An unnamed character vector defaults each concept to "mean"; a named character vector is interpreted as concept = aggregate shorthand. Example: list(hr = c("mean", "max"), sbp = "mean", gcs = "last", urine = "sum").

bin_min

Bin width in minutes (default 60). NULL disables binning and pivots on the raw timestamp. The emitted t_bin column is the 0-based bin index (floor(time / bin_min)), e.g. 0, 1, 2, ... for hourly bins.

analysis_level

"admission" (default) pivots ts_tab on time_since_hadm_min; "icu" pivots ts_icu on time_since_icu_min, keyed on assigned_icustay_id so each ICU stay is a separate observation on its own ICU clock.

window

Optional c(from_bin, to_bin) in bin-index units, inclusive both ends, restricting the output to those bins (applied in SQL before aggregation). E.g. with bin_min = 60, c(0, 47) keeps the first 48 h, c(0, 0) keeps only the first hour. NULL (default) keeps all bins.

complete_grid

If TRUE, emit a row for every bin in window (or, when window is NULL, the observed bin range) for each stay present in the long table, left-joining the aggregates onto the full grid so unmeasured bins come back as NA (no imputation - fill/mask downstream). Regularizes shape only, not length-of-stay eligibility. Requires non-NULL bin_min. Default FALSE.

n

Max rows to return. Default Inf.

cohort_only

If TRUE (default), pivot only rows of cohort members (cohort_index in this source's cohort_info), matched at the requested analysis_level: on the admission id for "admission", on the assigned ICU stay for "icu" (which needs cohort_info built with analysis_level = "icu"). Applied in SQL before aggregation. FALSE reads all imported context rows; it cannot recover data that was never imported.

clean

"none" (default) pivots the values as stored. "range" excludes readings outside each concept's physiologic [min, max] (both ends inclusive) in SQL, before aggregation, using the same bounds as clean_by_range(): the concept config's widest window across sources, matched on the exact concept name. Every aggregate is then computed over valid readings only (first/last/n are the first/last/number of valid readings), each concept gets a <concept>_n_cleaned column counting the readings excluded in that bin (0 for concepts with no bound, which are left unchanged with a message), and the result carries a clean_report attribute per concept: n, n_cleaned, n_not_numeric (missing or non-numeric values), min_value, max_value. A bin whose readings were all excluded is NA; _n_cleaned > 0 tells it apart from a bin with no measurement. With complete_grid, unmeasured grid bins have NA there too.

ranges

Optional bounds overriding the config, in the formats accepted by clean_by_range(): a named list of c(min, max) or a data frame with concept_name, min_value, max_value. Requires clean = "range".

con

Optional explicit DBI connection.

case_adm_only, scope_only

Removed; supplying either is an error. Use cohort_only.

Value

A wide data frame: id columns, the time-bin column (t_bin, or the raw time column when bin_min = NULL), then one column per concept and aggregate, named <concept>_<aggregate>, or just <concept> when the concept has one aggregate (followed by <concept>_n_cleaned with clean = "range").

Details

Time is binned by integer arithmetic on the minute axis (floor(time / bin_min) * bin_min), so multiple measurements of a concept that fall in the same bin are reconciled by the aggregate(s) you specify per concept. Set bin_min = NULL for a raw-timestamp pivot (no binning); ties at the exact same timestamp then collapse with the chosen aggregate.

Column naming: a concept with a single aggregate keeps its plain name (sbp); a concept with several aggregates is suffixed (hr_mean, hr_max).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
fetch_concepts_wide("mimic_iv_demo", spec = list(
  hr    = c("mean", "max"),
  sbp   = "mean",
  gcs   = "last",
  urine = "sum"
), bin_min = 60)

# Raw-timestamp pivot, ICU grain
fetch_concepts_wide("mimic_iv_demo", c(heart_rate = "mean"),
                    bin_min = NULL, analysis_level = "icu")

# All imported context rows, not only cohort members
fetch_concepts_wide("mimic_iv_demo", c(heart_rate = "mean"),
                    cohort_only = FALSE)
} # }
